name: Tangential acceleration
description: Tangential acceleration (a_T) is equal to the radius of the circle (r) multiplied by the angular acceleration (α).

name: Centripetal acceleration (using velocity)
description: Centripetal acceleration (a_c) is equal to the square of the tangential velocity (v) divided by the radius of the circle (r).

name: Centripetal acceleration (using angular velocity)
description: Centripetal acceleration (a_c) is equal to the radius of the circle (r) multiplied by the square of the angular velocity (ω).
